---
name: A project nxwright does not understand
about: nxwright warned of, or refused, something in a project file that it does not know
---

## The report

Run `nxwright report <your project.HMI> report.md`, read `report.md`, and paste it here.

The report holds none of your project's code, texts, names, pictures, fonts, or sounds, nor its password. Of each thing nxwright does not know, it gives at most its first 16 bytes, which may hold a text of yours: check them before you paste.

## The Nextion Editor

Which version saved the project? Its Help menu gives it.

## What you did

What did you do in the Nextion Editor before you saved the project? For example: added a component of a new type, or changed a setting.

## The project file

Could you share the project file privately, if nxwright's maintainers ask? Yes or no.
